### 1) What is on the screen
One roster frame on solid black. Top row: four standing humanoids labeled ZEUS, KRONOS, PERCY, MAN 1, sprites in region x,y,w,h ~ [20,28,228,64]. Bottom row: three standing humanoids labeled MAN 2, MAN 3, OURANOS in region [20,152,168,64]. The eye goes first to the KRONOS sprite in [84,28,40,64] because it is the only orange figure among blue/white/gray figures. The player is being asked to do nothing readable - there is no cursor, no prompt, no controls shown. I cannot see animation, gameplay, or anything outside this one frame.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
Hardware: 256x240, 8x8 tiles, BG palette changes only on 16x16, 4 BG x 3+backdrop + 4 sprite x 3+transparent, 25 colours max on screen, sprites 8x8 or 8x16, 64 OAM / 8 per scanline, no rotation, no alpha, no gradients, no anti-aliasing.
(a) PASS - palette count reads as NES: measured 11 distinct colours, inside the 25 ceiling, and measured every colour is a 64-entry NES palette entry.
(b) PASS - shading is flat, one colour per shape: torsos, heads, legs are solid fills with 1px hard steps, no gradient banding I can see.
(c) PASS - sprites read against background: blue/white/orange/gray objects on shared $0F black backdrop in [0,0,256,240] have clear silhouettes, no muddy shared BG colours.
(d) PASS - no anti-aliasing or soft edges: text glyphs and sprite edges are hard 1px blocks, including windowless labels, no blur.
(e) PASS - background colour changes land on grid trivially: background is one backdrop colour covering 74.1% of frame, no drifting 16x16 attribute breaks visible. Measured numbers agree with impression.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded in two horizontal bands: top labels+sprites in [0,4,256,100] and bottom labels+sprites in [0,132,256,84]. Empty where it matters: bottom strip in [0,216,256,24] is pure black, plus large black gutters between columns. Focal point KRONOS in [84,28,40,64] is left-of-center, not where a select cursor / prompt should be. All caps 8px text is legible at 256x240 at 1x, no guessing for letters.
Text regions: ZEUS in [22,4,36,8], KRONOS in [82,4,48,8], PERCY in [142,4,40,8], MAN 1 in [204,4,40,8], MAN 2 in [16,132,42,8], MAN 3 in [78,132,42,8], OURANOS in [138,132,60,10]. Worst is OURANOS in [138,132,60,10]: 7 glyphs crammed, centered ~8px right of its sprite center in [150,152,32,62], so the label visually belongs to the gap, not the gray figure, and at 1x the R-A-N run fills with no breathing room.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Blunt: this does not look AI generated. No pillow shading, no gradient mush, no gibberish glyphs, no soft borders, no stray-colour pixels, text sits on the 8px glyph grid, colours all belong to NES. It looks handmade and honest programmer art. What is off is design, not generation: MAN 1 in [212,28,36,62], MAN 2 in [24,152,36,62], MAN 3 in [88,152,36,62] are the same blue/white tile puppet copy-pasted three times; ZEUS and MANs share the same blue palette; OURANOS is the same puppet in gray. That reads as placeholder roster, not final cast - a prompt would have varied shapes, this has varied labels on identical structure.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Bottom void in [0,208,256,32]: draw one centered 8px prompt row "PICK WITH START" in NES $30 white on $0F black, tile-aligned, to give the frame a task. Do not leave 32px of nothing.
2. Duplicate in [24,152,36,62] MAN 2 sprite: keep silhouette, swap pants/boots fill from NES $12 dark blue to NES $16 red, using a second sprite palette, so MAN 1/2/3 are not identical. Keep white $30 chest.
3. Label mis-centering in [138,132,60,10] OURANOS text: redraw same 7 glyphs moved left by 8 pixels to [130,132,60,10] so text center matches sprite center in [150,152,32,62], 8px per glyph, no half-tile offset.
4. Column grid in [150,28,36,62] PERCY column and [212,28,36,62] MAN 1 column: shift each left by 8 pixels to land sprite left edges on 16x16 attribute boundaries, evening gutters to full 16px instead of ~10px/22px drift.
5. Chest detail in [26,50,32,14] ZEUS/MAN chest blocks and [90,50,32,14] KRONOS chest: replace 2px-tall light-blue $3C inner highlight with flat $30 white single block, remove 1px cheek dither pixels in [28,38,28,6], to simplify to one colour per shape readable at 2 meters.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
nes_authenticity: 8 - palette, tiles, flat fills all legal.
readability: 6 - glyphs legible but duplicates confuse and no prompt.
charm: 4 - honest but three copy-paste men and dead bottom third.
